name: Gourmethotel Unterwirt
beschreibung: The Gourmet Hotel Unterwirt is located in the Tirol municipality of Ebbs, not far from the border with Bayern. The hotel is part of Genuss-Hotels Österreichs and focuses on upscale regional cuisine. The restaurant offers seasonal dishes with products from the surrounding area. The rooms are comfortably furnished and offer mountain views. A wellness area with a Finnish sauna and steam bath is available. Ebbs is a suitable starting point for hikes and bike tours in the Kaisergebirge. In winter, guests can use the nearby ski areas.
